faq.a: Zawadi is associated with the Arabic form زَوَادِي, whose core sense is zawadi; gift, present (swahili form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Zawadi?
faq.a: Zawadi is associated with Arabic. Zawadi is the Swahili form of Arabic زَاد (zād), meaning 'gift, present'.
Yes — the underlying form زَوَادِي is Arabic.
Zawadi can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Zawadi should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Zād is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.a: In Urdu, Zawadi is rendered زوادی and carries the sense زوادی، تحفہ.

faq.q: What does Zawadi mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Zawadi is rendered زوادی and carries the sense زوادی، هدیه.
A romanized syllable approximation is za-wa-di. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Zawadi, zawadi. Script forms are زوادي, زوادی, زَوَادِي, ज़वादी.

faq.q: Is Zawadi a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
